name: ad_account_change
description: AD 账户变更日志 (R158.72.x + R158.72.x.1 + R158.72.x.2 + R158.72.x.3 + R158.72.x.4 + R158.72.x.5 + R158.72.x.6 + R158.72.x.7 + R158.72.x.8 + R158.72.x.9 + R158.72.x.10, 2026-10-16) — 5 种动作类型 (创建/修改/删除/启用/禁用), 24h cadence (intervalSec=86400). R158.72.x fix: 5 actions 互斥状态机, 5 events 1:1 映射. R158.72.x.1 fix: Get-ADReplicationAttributeMetadata -Server $server + _.AttributeName 列名修. R158.72.x.2 fix: Import-Module ActiveDirectory 加 inner try/catch. R158.72.x.3: 操作员 directive '不停执行导致 AD 出问题' 硬删整包 (DELETE package_scripts + package_policies 2 表 + 5 段 pending_trigger cancelled). R158.72.x.4 fix: 走 Get-WinEvent Security 日志 5 events 1:1 映射 (4720/4722/4725/4738/4767 → created/enabled/disabled/modified/unlocked), 0 依赖 Import-Module ActiveDirectory, 0 触 AD: PSDrive mount, NSSM context 友好. +1 字段 operator_user (事件 Properties[4] SubjectUserName 操作人). 中心端公共表 schema 改 (ALTER TABLE ad_account_change ADD operator_user NVARCHAR(128) NULL), etl 1:1 平行, 前端 AccountChangeDetailView 7 → 8 列. R158.72.x.5 fix: R158.72.x.4 ship 后 33 fleet AD agent PS parser 报 3 错 (77 行 6 列 Missing '=' operator after key in hash literal + 83 行 5 列 Unexpected 'catch'), 真因 hashtable 4767 KV 行尾紧跟中文长注释 + 后续嵌套 try + Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable 组合触发 PS5.1 lexer bug. 修法: 那行中文注释挪到 hashtable 闭合 `}` 之后独立一行, PS parser 0 错. R158.72.x.6 fix: ship 1h probe (KDLSYOFADSRV1) 报 'Get-WinEvent Security failed: 在 Id 哈希表项中遇到 Null 值. 不允许使用 Null 值.' 真因 PS5.1 `$eventIdToAction.Keys` 出来是 KeyCollection (元素 boxed Object), Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable Id 字段要纯 Int32[]; 强转 `[int[]]` 1 行修. R158.72.x.7 fix: 1.0.3 ship 完被 builtin-seed-upgrade 覆盖回 1.0.2 真因 (builtin-packages.js:512 漏同步修), 4 步 atomic 重 ship (备份 1.0.2 / DELETE 1.0.2 / INSERT 1.0.3 / builtin-packages.js:512 同步). R158.72.x.8: bump 1.0.3 → 1.0.4 (同 .ps1 file 只改 version 字段, 走 builtin-seed-upgrade 自动). R158.72.x.9 fix: 1.0.4 ship 后 KDLSYOFADSRV1 手动跑报 'Get-WinEvent Security failed: 找不到任何与指定的选择条件匹配的事件.' (NoMatchingEventsFound 异常) + error_code:1, 真因 auditpol 未配时 Get-WinEvent 0 匹配是 expected outcome 但 catch 块当 fail. 1.0.5 fix: catch 块识别 NoMatchingEventsFound (msg like '*No events were found*' OR fqid like '*NoMatchingEventsFound*') → 静默 + $events=@() + 0 lastErrorMessage (error_code=0). 其他异常 (权限错 EventLogNotFoundException, log 不存在) 仍 error_code:1. 跟 R158.50.6 ad_lockout_list 同一类 fix 1:1 平行. R158.72.x.9.b follow-up: stderr 'Get-WinEvent Security: 0 events in window (...) — $msg' 中文 em dash (U+2014) + 中文注解 在 PS5.1 stderr codepage (GBK) 控制台显示乱码. 1.0.5.b fix: stderr 改纯英文 tag (auditpol not configured or no change today) + ASCII hyphen 替 em dash. PS5.1 [Console]::Error 没 OutputEncoding setter 抛 InvalidOperation, 走 .NET exception message ($msg) 自身 codepage 无法控制, 但操作员看 stderr 看英文 tag 已足够. R158.72.x.10 fix: 1.0.5 0 事件时仍走 [Console]::Error.WriteLine 写 stderr (英文 tag, 治标不治本), + 单事件 Properties parse 失败时也走 stderr. 操作员 directive '按道理应该直接就是 0,或者 json 数据, 而不是 报错'. 1.0.6 fix: (1) 0 事件 catch 块 = 静默, $events=@() + 0 stderr. 真异常 (EventLogNotFoundException, 权限错) 仍 stderr + error_code=1, 跟 R158.50.6 1:1 平行. (2) 单事件 parse 失败 catch = 静默 (整 batch continue, 0 走 stderr). 真 init 异常 (try 块最外层) 仍 stderr + error_code=1. 0 影响中心端 wire shape (stdout JSON 字段 1:1 平行), R158.50.6 decision tree (runner.js:786-790) 自动处理 error_code:0/1 不变. 前置条件 (操作员必先配, 0 改中心端): (1) 域控 auditpol /set /subcategory:'User Account Management' /success:enable /failure:enable; (2) agent run-as account 加进 DC 本地 'Event Log Readers' 组. ship 后 1h+24h+72h 必 3 次 partial ratio verify ≥80% (R158.100.A.1 #1 lesson 跟 R158.99 1:1).
